note: They didn't say anything during this session.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Hello, Mom. Let's look back at a visit together.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Mom, there's a blue tablecloth on the long table that says "Hardware Lab" in white letters. It has big MLH letters in red, blue and yellow, with "Major League Hacking" underneath. Three boxes are stacked at the end of the table: white on top, red in the middle, and yellow at the bottom.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Mom, behind the table the walls were plain and white. A person in dark clothes was lying on the floor by the wall.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: There is a second blue table beside the first one. It has stacks of cards and small papers spread out on it. The floor under it all is dark, worn concrete.
